# Cascade settings for the entry server: the SEED for a new server
# (cascade/deploy.sh copies it only where there is none). On a running server
# the settings live in the database and /root/awg/cascade/cascade.conf is
# compiled from it by the agent — change them with
# `docker exec vpn-agent python -m awgscale.agent cascade-set <base64 of the document>`.
CLIENT_IF="awg0"
CLIENT_SUBNET="172.16.17.0/24"

# What goes abroad (only the list, or everything foreign) is switched in the
# panel and kept in the database; the watch service reads the compiled route.mode.

# In list mode: also send UDP (except port 443) to non-Russian addresses abroad.
# This is what makes calls work in WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Meet, FaceTime…
# Side effect: online games on foreign servers go through the exit too.
UDP_VIA_EXIT=1

# "index:interface:tunnel address of the entry on that exit:display name:weight"
# Weight = share of clients. 2 and 1 → clients 1,2 on the first exit, client 3 on
# the second, clients 4,5 on the first, and so on.
# Add a line per exit, after its link exists:
#   cascade/link-exit-kernel.sh  dedicated kernel tunnel (awgk<N>)  — both exits
# The old container links (awgx1 10.8.1.250, awgx2 10.8.1.251) are switched off
# on this server; their configs are kept in /etc/amnezia/amneziawg as spares.
# Index 2 is free (it was awgx2). After removing a line, `apply` does not clean
# up that index: delete its two `ip rule`s, flush table 200+N, destroy cx_<N>.
EXITS=(
    "1:awgk1:10.77.1.2:exit1-nl:2"
    "3:awgk2:10.77.2.2:exit2-nl:1"
)

# This server's own DNS upstreams (AdGuard Home) — resolved through an exit
DNS_VIA_EXIT=(1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1 9.9.9.9)

# Local (Docker) subnets whose outgoing traffic must leave through an exit.
# 172.30.99.0/24 = the Telegram bot's network (stack/compose.yml): Telegram's
# API is unreliable straight from a Russian address.
VIA_EXIT_SUBNETS=(172.30.99.0/24)

# Health-probe targets, pinged through each exit
PROBE_TARGETS=(1.1.1.1 9.9.9.9)

# Addresses to force through the Russian side despite the list (space separated)
EXTRA_RU_NETS=""

# (cascade/deploy.sh copies it only where there is none). On a running server
# the settings live in the database and /root/awg/cascade/cascade.conf is
# compiled from it by the agent — change them with
# `docker exec vpn-agent python -m awgscale.agent cascade-set <base64 of the document>`.
CLIENT_IF="awg0"
CLIENT_SUBNET="172.16.17.0/24"

# What goes abroad (only the list, or everything foreign) is switched in the
# panel and kept in the database; the watch service reads the compiled route.mode.

# In list mode: also send UDP (except port 443) to non-Russian addresses abroad.
# This is what makes calls work in WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Meet, FaceTime…
# Side effect: online games on foreign servers go through the exit too.
UDP_VIA_EXIT=1

# "index:interface:tunnel address of the entry on that exit:display name:weight"
# Weight = share of clients. 2 and 1 → clients 1,2 on the first exit, client 3 on
# the second, clients 4,5 on the first, and so on.
# Add a line per exit, after its link exists:
#   cascade/link-exit-kernel.sh  dedicated kernel tunnel (awgk<N>)  — both exits
# The old container links (awgx1 10.8.1.250, awgx2 10.8.1.251) are switched off
# on this server; their configs are kept in /etc/amnezia/amneziawg as spares.
# Index 2 is free (it was awgx2). After removing a line, `apply` does not clean
# up that index: delete its two `ip rule`s, flush table 200+N, destroy cx_<N>.
EXITS=(
    "1:awgk1:10.77.1.2:exit1-nl:2"
    "3:awgk2:10.77.2.2:exit2-nl:1"
)

# This server's own DNS upstreams (AdGuard Home) — resolved through an exit
DNS_VIA_EXIT=(1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1 9.9.9.9)

# Local (Docker) subnets whose outgoing traffic must leave through an exit.
# 172.30.99.0/24 = the Telegram bot's network (stack/compose.yml): Telegram's
# API is unreliable straight from a Russian address.
VIA_EXIT_SUBNETS=(172.30.99.0/24)

# Health-probe targets, pinged through each exit
PROBE_TARGETS=(1.1.1.1 9.9.9.9)

# Addresses to force through the Russian side despite the list (space separated)
EXTRA_RU_NETS=""
